set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0126 NEW)

include(GNUInstallDirs)

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${SLXIO_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS})
set(SIMDJSON_BUILD_STATIC_LIB OFF)
if(SLXIO_BUILD_SHARED_AND_STATIC_LIBS)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON)
    set(SIMDJSON_BUILD_STATIC_LIB ON)
elseif(SLXIO_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS AND SLXIO_BUILD_STATIC_LIBS)
    set(SIMDJSON_BUILD_STATIC_LIB ON)
endif()

set(SIMDJSON_ENABLE_THREADS ON)
set(SIMDJSON_DISABLE_DEPRECATED_API OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_DEVELOPMENT_CHECKS OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_ENABLE_MEMORY_FILE_MAPPING_ON_WINDOWS OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_MINUS_ZERO_AS_FLOAT OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_ENABLE_NAN_INF OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_EXCEPTIONS ON)
set(SIMDJSON_STATIC_REFLECTION_MODE "AUTO")
set(SIMDJSON_INSTALL ${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS})
set(SIMDJSON_SINGLEHEADER ON)
set(SIMDJSON_INSTALL_CMAKEDIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/simdjson")
set(SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION "")
set(SIMDJSON_EXCLUDE_IMPLEMENTATION "")
set(SIMDJSON_BUILTIN_IMPLEMENTATION "")
set(SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_FALLBACK ON)
set(SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_WESTMERE ON)
set(SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_HASWELL ON)
set(SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_ICELAKE ON)
set(SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_ARM64 ON)
set(SIMDJSON_IMPLEMENTATION_PPC64 ON)
set(SIMDJSON_CHECK_EOF OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_SANITIZE_UNDEFINED OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_SANITIZE OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_SANITIZE_MEMORY OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_SANITIZE_THREADS OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_USE_LIBCPP OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_STRUCTURAL_INDEXER_STEP "")
set(SIMDJSON_VISUAL_STUDIO_BUILD_WITH_DEBUG_INFO_FOR_PROFILING OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_BASH ON)
set(SIMDJSON_VERBOSE_LOGGING OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_AVX512_ALLOWED ON)
set(SIMDJSON_SKIPUTF8VALIDATION OFF)
set(SIMDJSON_DEVELOPER_MODE OFF)

add_subdirectory(src)
